item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-13 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. Toward Trustworthy Robot-Assisted Sliding Palpation for Shallow Vessel Localisation with a Calibrated Digital Twin — 迈向可信的机器人辅助滑动触诊：基于校准数字孪生的浅表血管定位 (75/100)
  2. Semi-Supervised Hyperspectral Image Classification with Edge-Aware Superpixel Label Propagation and Adaptive Pseudo-Labeling — 基于边缘感知超像素标签传播与自适应伪标签的半监督高光谱影像分类 (75/100)
  3. Asymptotic theory and inference for non-stationary and non-mixing triangular arrays of random fields — 非平稳非混合三角阵列随机场的渐近理论与推断 (75/100)
  4. Deep graph kernel point processes over networks — 网络上的深度图核点过程 (75/100)
  5. Mapping forest structure: A 3D deep learning benchmark for ground-based LiDAR — 绘制森林结构：基于地面LiDAR的3D深度学习基准 (70/100)
  6. Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild — 复制解释了野外AI智能体的集体行为 (70/100)
  7. Weakly supervised neural network: segmentation of complex structures in X-ray microCT — 弱监督神经网络：X射线微CT中复杂结构的分割 (70/100)
  8. Radiation, Rotation and Scale Invariant Feature Descriptor for Multimodal Image Matching — 用于多模态图像匹配的辐射、旋转和尺度不变特征描述子 (70/100)
  9. TRIPPULSE: Multi-Agent Travel Planning with Review-Grounded Reasoning — TRIPPULSE：基于评论推理的多智能体旅行规划 (70/100)
  10. GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation — GeoAgent：通过具身导航评估VLM地理定位能力 (70/100)
